<section>Chapter 31. Cryptography Extensions: Scalar & Entropy Source Instructions, Version 1.0.1 > 31.4. Instructions > 31.4.4. aes32esmi > Description</section>
<previous>#### **Encoding**

|31 30|29|25 24||20|19||15|14|12|11||7|6|0|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|bs|1|0 0 1 1|rs2|||rs1||0|0 0||rd||0 1 1|0 0 1 1|</previous>
<target>#### **Description**

This instruction sources a single byte from `rs2` according to `bs` . To this it applies the forward AES SBox operation, and a partial forward MixColumn, before XOR’ing the result with `rs1` . This instruction must _always_ be implemented such that its execution latency does not depend on the data being operated on.</target>
<next>#### **Operation**

```
function clause execute (AES32ESMI (bs,rs2,rs1,rd)) = {
  let shamt   : bits( 5) = bs @ 0b000; /* shamt = bs*8 */
  let si      : bits( 8) = (X(rs2)[31..0] >> shamt)[7..0]; /* SBox Input */
  let so      : bits( 8) = aes_sbox_fwd(si);
  let mixed   : bits(32) = aes_mixcolumn_byte_fwd(so);
  let result  : bits(32) = X(rs1)[31..0] ^ rol32(mixed, unsigned(shamt));
  X(rd) = EXTS(result); RETIRE_SUCCESS
}
```</next>
